application_credentials.description:
Withings to Garmin Sync needs a Withings client ID and secret.

1. Go to the [Withings Developer Dashboard]({developer_dashboard_url}) (Public Cloud) and log in.
1. Select **Create an application** and tick **Public API integration**.
1. Choose **Development** as the target environment and enter a name and description.
1. Enter `{redirect_url}` as the registered callback URL. Don't press the button to test it.
1. Enter the client ID and secret shown in the dashboard here.
